title: The Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax (Compensation to the Local Authorities) Act, 2017
full_text: The Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax (Compensation to the Local Authorities) Act, 2017 महाराष्ट्र वस्तू व सेवा कर (स्थानिक प्राधिकरणांना भरपाई देण्याबाबत) अधिनियम, २०१७. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201741 Act Number: 41 Enactment Date: 2017-05-29 Act Year: 2017 Short Title: The Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax (Compensation to the Local Authorities) Act, 2017 Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र वस्तू व सेवा कर (स्थानिक प्राधिकरणांना भरपाई देण्याबाबत) अधिनियम, २०१७. Long Title: An Act to provide for compensation to the Municipal Corporation of Brihan Mumbai and other local authorities for loss of revenue arising on account of abolition of octroi and local body tax, due to implementation of the goods and services tax and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
